_comment: Files allowed to call bootStderr with a message the AST gate cannot prove
secret-free. Empty by design: all three current call sites build their
message from string literals, a closed union (KeyName), and numbers.
Adding an entry means accepting a raw, unredacted console write whose
content is only guaranteed by review. Prefer restructuring the call to use
a closed type over adding an exemption here.
Stale entries fail the gate: an exemption for a file that no longer calls
bootStderr hides the next real one.
